RTB-2026-RENT-CAP-001.what_we_say: For applicable private residential tenancies from 1 March 2026, the general annual rent-increase rule is 2% or CPI, whichever is lower, subject to applicable exceptions.
RTB-2026-RENT-CAP-001.why_we_say_it: The RTB's current official guidance states this rule and identifies the Residential Tenancies Act 2004, as amended, as the definitive legal framework. The Residential Tenancies (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 2026 contains the statutory amendments.

official_guidance.name: RTB — Setting and reviewing private rents from 1 March 2026

RTB-2026-RENT-CAP-001.what_it_means: This is a general rule only; tenancy classification, timing and exceptions must still be checked.
RTB-2026-RENT-CAP-001.how_it_applies: The engine must compose the proposition with the tenancy generation and applicable exceptions before an individual result is produced.

RTB-2026-RENT-RESET-002.what_we_say: Certain private tenancies created from 1 March 2026 have specified circumstances in which rent may be reset to market rent.
RTB-2026-RENT-RESET-002.why_we_say_it: The current RTB guidance identifies the permitted circumstances and the 2026 statutory framework supplies the legal amendments.

official_guidance.name: RTB — Setting and reviewing private rents from 1 March 2026

RTB-2026-RENT-RESET-002.what_it_means: A market-rent reset is conditional; it is not a universal right to reset rent.
RTB-2026-RENT-RESET-002.how_it_applies: The engine must determine the tenancy generation and the statutory circumstances before applying this proposition.

RTB-2026-APARTMENT-003.what_we_say: A qualifying new-apartment rule can remove the 2% ceiling so that the annual increase is linked to CPI, where the statutory conditions are met.
RTB-2026-APARTMENT-003.why_we_say_it: Current RTB guidance identifies qualifying construction commenced from 10 June 2025 and describes the applicable conditions.

official_guidance.name: RTB — Setting and reviewing private rents from 1 March 2026

RTB-2026-APARTMENT-003.what_it_means: The construction commencement fact must be established; the age of an apartment alone is not enough.
RTB-2026-APARTMENT-003.how_it_applies: The engine must collect and verify the relevant construction/building-control facts and other statutory conditions.
